### Verification
Before submitting a new pull request please verify and check the following:
- [ ] I checked if there is no similar pull request already submitted
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my changes
- [ ] I have commented my changes (particularly in hard-to-understand areas)
- [ ] I have tested my changes and they do not generate new warnings and errors
- [ ] This pull request is not targeting the main branch of this repository
- [ ] My changes follow the guidelines of this project

### Pull request type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code style update (refactoring)
- [ ] Other

### Related reports
List of related issues, feature requests and documentation updates if applicable. If suggesting a new feature or change that that is not reported/documented, please create an adequate bug report, feature request, or documentation update first.

### Description
Detailed description of the changes in this pull request

### Tests (if applicable)
Describe the tests you ran/did to verify your changes. Provide instructions so we can reproduce and list any relevant details for your test configuration. 

**Test config:**
- OS: [e.g. Windows, Linux]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox]
- Browser version [e.g. 1.0.0]

### Additional context
Any relevant screenshots, links, and/or resources.
